changelog:
Initial release of the discord skill for Clawdbot, enabling Discord control and access to powerful AI models via SkillBoss.

- Send and manage Discord messages, reactions, stickers, emojis, and more directly from Clawdbot.
- Access 50+ models for image/video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, music, chat, document parsing, web search, email, and SMS.
- Easily use SkillBoss API with unified authentication via SKILLBOSS_API_KEY.
- Comprehensive usage examples and parameter documentation included in SKILL.md.
summary: Control Discord from Clawdbot: send messages, react, post stickers, upload emojis, and more. And also 50+ models for image generation, video generation, text...
